Great AI App. I’ve tried a lot of AI apps, and this one really stands out. I love the relationship progression feature seeing the connection evolve from acquaintances to deeper levels makes interactions feel more meaningful and intentional. The relationship bar is such a fun and motivating touch.

I also really appreciate how accessible the app is. There are plenty of easy ways to earn drops, which makes it feel rewarding to explore and engage without pressure. Overall, the app feels thoughtfully designed, intuitive, and genuinely enjoyable to use.
So fun. The best roleplaying app out in the app store
